newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Vacant space in Canadian Prairie primary grain elevators fell to 22 percent in the week ended July 20, the Canadian Wheat Board said.
The 22 percent elevator vacancy rate was down from 27 percent on July 13, the Board said.
Manitoba elevators had the most free space at 29 percent, Alberta was next at 25 percent followed by Saskatchewan at 18 percent.
Vancouver unloaded 3,035 railcars versus the 3,300 target. Prince Rupert unloaded 1,259 railcars versus the 900 target. Thunder Bay unloaded 3,435 railcars versus the 3,550 target.
